mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies at the Military Ridge State Trail and a beautiful First Quarter moon. Keep an eye out for the International Space Station flying from the direction of Belleville toward Fitchburg and Madison at 4:54 AM. The overnight low will reach 40 degrees, and we are not expecting any rain.

Our top stories include the arrest of a school bus driver on Thursday following reports of impaired driving, and a reminder to visit the city website to find your designated polling location for upcoming elections.
We have a busy couple of days ahead with live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company happening tomorrow, followed by yoga at Insight Wellness on October 19.
On Thursday, October 15, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for operating while impaired after receiving reports of dangerous driving behavior while students were on board.
We have finished serving our Chocolate Volcano for the day. We look forward to seeing you tomorrow at 10:00 AM when we will feature our delicious Mint Cookie flavor.
